Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ProductVariantSupport

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ProductVariantSupport
@Component public class ProductVariantSupport extends Object
Parse / lookup / aggregate Ledgerly-style sparse size×color variant matrices stored on Product.
